outcomeNote: Attribution of R' Yehuda's reasoning to R' Yosei's principle

segments.he: אָמַר רַבִּי יְהוּדָה, לֹא תְּהֵא מְחִיצָה. אָמַר רַבָּה בַּר בַּר חָנָה אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן: רַבִּי יְהוּדָה בְּשִׁיטַת רַבִּי יוֹסֵי אֲמָרָהּ, דְּאָמַר: מְחִיצָה תְּלוּיָה מַתֶּרֶת אֲפִילּוּ בַּיַּבָּשָׁה.
segments.en: The mishna teaches: «Rabbi Yehuda said:» There is no need for a partition in the cistern, as «a partition» inside a cistern «is no» better than the wall above it. «Rabba bar bar Ḥana said» that «Rabbi Yoḥanan said: Rabbi Yehuda stated this in accordance with the opinion of Rabbi Yosei, who said: A suspended partition permits» carrying «even on land,» as it is considered as though it descended to the ground and sealed off the area. Accordingly, there is no need to erect a partition inside the airspace of a cistern.
